findings.message: GSAP tween on "__unresolved__" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: left. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: replace left with the transform equivalent (x), e.g. tl.fromTo("__unresolved__", { x: -1300 }, { x: 0, ...yourAnimation }). Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.

Adolescent gun violence remains a persistent public health concern, yet most prevention
programs are judged by short-term arrest counts rather than lasting outcomes
. School-based mentoring shows promise, but follow-up rarely

of sustained participation, is seldom measured at all . This study
addresses that gap by following community-based early intervention over a longer horizon.
